event: Free shoppers scan without limit, so nobody has a reason to buy Pexi Plus.
trigger: The weekly limits are unset on the Mac, so the 10 free and 100 Plus scans a week are not enforced; production also has no invite gate.
cost: Lost subscription revenue from day one of paid launch; every Plus sale depends on the free limit biting.
detect: Nobody would know from an alarm. Revenue would simply stay near zero; only a look at scan counts per device would show it.
response: 1. Set SHIN_FREE_SCANS_PER_WEEK=10 and SHIN_PLUS_SCANS_PER_WEEK=100 in the Mac config. 2. Restart the server. 3. Scan 11 times on a test phone and confirm the paywall appears.
response_exists: yes: docs/launch-gaps-2026-11-06.md item 2 and docs/security-check/v4-v5-poison-dynamic.md fix line say what to set
smallest_fix: Set the two values, restart, and run the 11-scan check on a phone. Switch on only once a test purchase unlocks scanning end to end (decisions.md:1967), so the paywall never traps a tester.

event: A shopper pays for Pexi Plus and still hits the free limit, or a shopper's purchase never reaches the server.
trigger: Apple sale succeeds but the Plus status does not reach the server (RevenueCat link, device id mismatch, old build).
cost: Refund requests, 1-star reviews, lost paying user; each affected subscriber is CA$29.99 a year at stake.
detect: Only a shopper's email or review. No check compares sales against unlocked devices.
response: 1. Ask the shopper to tap Restore purchases on the paywall. 2. If that fails, look the device id up in RevenueCat. 3. Grant the entitlement by hand or point them to Apple for a refund.
response_exists: no
smallest_fix: Do one sandbox purchase on a real phone, then write the three-step support reply on the support page. Restore exists in the app; the lookup step is not written.

event: An iPhone subscriber cannot find where to cancel or manage Plus inside the app.
trigger: The You screen has a manage-subscription row for Android only; a test even asserts there is none on iOS.
cost: Quebec's 2026 cancellation-button amendments and Apple's subscription rules are both named in the legal review; plus refund requests and 1-star reviews from people who feel trapped.
detect: Apple review might flag it; otherwise a shopper's complaint. No alarm.
response: 1. Add a Manage or cancel subscription row on iOS that opens the Apple subscriptions page. 2. Update the test that asserts no manage row. 3. Ship in the next build.
response_exists: yes: docs/store/index.html explains cancelling, but not inside the app (partial)
smallest_fix: The iOS link already exists as MANAGE_URLS.ios in plus-config.js; change the one line in you.js that returns it for Android only, and fix the test.

response: 1. Reply the same day. 2. Send reportaproblem.apple.com and the Apple refund steps. 3. Tell them to cancel in Apple subscriptions. No refund is issued by Pexi.
response_exists: yes: docs/security-check/legal-review-2026-11-17.md (parent refund line) and docs/store/index.html (refunds via Apple)
smallest_fix: Save the reply as a text snippet, and make people-05 real so someone sees the mail.

event: Someone attacks the home server, or reaches the Mac through the open home network.

response_exists: yes: docs/privacy/breach-plan.md

fix_cost: 1 to 2 hours (a FileVault encrypt takes time but works in the background)
